# India's Next Dancer 2027 — full reference

Website: https://indianextdancer.com/
Organiser: KGIL Productions (registered in Pune, Maharashtra, India; parent: Kgil Productions)
Last updated: 24 November 2026

## What is India's Next Dancer 2027?

India's Next Dancer 2027 is a nationwide freestyle dance competition presented by KGIL Productions. It runs city auditions in 10 major cities across India, followed by city-level semifinals and a live National Grand Finale in Mumbai in July 2027, judged by celebrity judges. Its tagline is "One stage. One dream."

## Who can take part?

Anyone in one of four categories:

| Category | Who | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Kids | 5–12 years old | Solo |
| Teens | 13–19 years old | Solo |
| Adults | 20 years and above | Solo |
| Group | Crews of 2–10 members | Group |

Participants under 18 need consent from a parent or legal guardian. Proof of age may be requested.

## What dance styles are allowed?

The competition is freestyle: every dance form is welcome — for example hip-hop, Bharatanatyam, contemporary, Bollywood, kathak, krump, folk, or a fusion of your own.

## How does the competition work?

1. City auditions — run in 10 major cities across India. Perform your style for the panel.
2. City semifinals — selected performers from the auditions move on to the city-level semifinal.
3. National Grand Finale — finalists from every city perform live in Mumbai in front of celebrity judges.

Audition cities and dates will be announced when registration opens.

## What are the prizes?

Each of the four categories crowns two winners:

- 1st place: ₹5,00,000 per category
- 2nd place: ₹2,00,000 per category

Total prize pool: ₹28,00,000 (4 categories × ₹7,00,000). Eight dancers or crews win prize money. For Group entries the prize is awarded to the crew.

## When do registrations open?

Registrations open soon. People can leave their name, mobile number, preferred audition city and category on the website to be notified when registration opens, together with the audition date for their city. Signing up for notifications is not itself a registration.

## Where is the Grand Finale?

Mumbai, Maharashtra, in July 2027.
